definition_en: not large in size, amount, or age

senses.title: Not large in size
senses.example: This shirt is too small for me.
senses.exampleCN: 这件衬衫对我来说太小了。
senses.why: Old English smæl first meant slender and narrow, then widened to cover anything below the usual size.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 smæl 原指细长狭窄，后来扩大指一切小于常规尺寸的东西。

senses.title: Young in age
senses.example: He learned to swim when he was small.
senses.exampleCN: 他很小的时候就学会了游泳。
senses.why: Because a young child is physically small, the size word took on the sense of young age.
senses.whyCN: 因为幼童身形小，这个尺寸词就引申出年幼之义。

senses.title: Low in amount or importance
senses.example: They started with a small business.
senses.exampleCN: 他们从一家小生意做起。

senses.whyCN: 规模小的生意在资金和范围上也小，于是这个词也指不大的规模。

definition_en: clever, neat and well dressed, or to feel a sharp pain
core_image: 男孩把坏掉的闹钟修好，爷爷摸着他的头夸他聪明
scene: 男孩把坏掉的闹钟修好，爷爷摸着他的头夸他聪明The boy fixed the broken alarm clock, and his grandpa said he was smart.
sceneCN: 这里 smart 是「聪明的」（第 01 个义项）；句意是她对这个问题给出了聪明的回答。

pos.zh: 形容词：聪明的、整洁漂亮的

senses.title: Quick to learn and understand
senses.example: She gave a smart answer to the question.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这个问题给出了聪明的回答。
senses.why: Smart comes from Old English smeortan, to feel pain; a sharp mind cuts as quickly as a sting.
senses.whyCN: smart 源自古英语 smeortan（感到疼痛）；敏锐的头脑像刺痛一样来得快。

senses.title: Neat and well dressed
senses.example: He looks smart in his new suit.
senses.exampleCN: 他穿新西装显得很精神。
senses.why: A well-dressed person makes a clean, sharp impression, so the word moved from pain to style.
senses.whyCN: 衣着讲究的人给人干净利落的印象，词义便从疼痛转向外表。

senses.title: To feel a sharp pain
senses.example: My eyes smart when I cut onions.
senses.exampleCN: 切洋葱时我的眼睛刺痛。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense: a small, sharp pain, still used for stings and sore eyes.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的含义：细小而尖锐的痛，至今仍用于蛰伤与眼睛酸痛。

senses.whyCN: 若一事随另一事而来，swa 标记这层连接，so 就成了表结果的词。

senses.title: Very, used for emphasis

definition_en: to remain in a place, to continue in a state, or a temporary period of living somewhere
core_image: 雨夜里客人留在门口，伞还滴着水
scene: 雨夜里客人留在门口，伞还滴着水On the rainy night the guest stays at the door, his umbrella still dripping.

senses.title: To remain in a place
senses.example: We stayed at home all day.
senses.why: From Latin stare, to stand, through Old French, stay first meant to stand firm and then to remain.
senses.whyCN: 经古法语源自拉丁语 stare（站立），stay 先指站稳，后指停留。

senses.title: To continue in a state
senses.example: The shop stays open late.
senses.why: If a thing keeps standing in the same condition, English says it stays that way.
senses.whyCN: 若事物一直立在同一状态，英语就说它 stays 如此。

senses.title: A period of living somewhere temporarily
senses.definition: A period of living somewhere temporarily
senses.example: Our stay in the village was short.

definition_en: demanding that rules be followed, or exact and carefully limited
